name: The Righteous Gemstones
description: The story of a world-famous televangelist family with a history of deviance, greed and, yes, charitable work, all in the name of Jesus.

videos.title: The Righteous Gemstones
videos.overview: Upon returning from a baptism marathon in China, Jesse receives a video from blackmailers seeking to sully his reputation. Eli moves forward with plans to expand the Gemstone empire as he continues to mourn his late wife.

videos.title: Is This the Man Who Made the Earth Tremble
videos.overview: After discovering Amber, Pontius and Abraham reminiscing about an estranged family member, Jesse tasks his friends with acquiring surveillance footage that could explain the strange events of the night before.

videos.title: They Are Weak, But He Is Strong
videos.overview: Aimee-Leigh's elderly brother Baby Billy returns to the Gemstone ministry, bringing along his much younger wife Tiffany. Jesse closes ranks on his co-conspirators to root out the identity of his blackmailers.

videos.title: Wicked Lips
videos.overview: Judy and Martin take Gideon behind-the scenes of the Gemstone enterprise. Eli tasks Kelvin with doing a “satanic sweep” for Dot, the rebellious teen daughter of the church’s biggest donors. Jesse and his friends are thrown for a loop when Chad’s wife finds some disturbing emails.

videos.title: Interlude
videos.overview: In 1989, young Jesse, Judy and Baby Billy each deal with the news that Aimee-Leigh is pregnant in their own unique way, while Eli looks to grow his family’s prospects.

videos.title: Now the Sons of Eli Were Worthless Men
videos.overview: Jealous of Kelvin’s rising star, Judy seeks her moment in the spotlight under Baby Billy’s tutelage. Jesse procures a key piece of evidence he hopes will lead to the blackmailers.

videos.title: And Yet One of You is a Devil
videos.overview: Eli informs Jesse, Kelvin and Judy that they’ll each need to be front and center for Easter Sunday service, their biggest telecast of the year. Judy’s deference to Baby Billy threatens her relationship with BJ and with her family.

videos.title: But the Righteous Will See Their Fall
videos.overview: Jesse deals with the fallout of the dramatic events of Easter Sunday. Judy attempts to win back BJ after receiving some harsh words from Baby Billy. Kelvin has a crisis of faith.

videos.title: Better is the End of a Thing Than Its Beginning
videos.overview: Eli questions his children's future in the Gemstone ministry. Jesse struggles to keep his marriage together. Judy opens up to BJ about her past. A disillusioned Kelvin embraces his dark side. Season One Finale.

videos.title: I Speak in the Tongues of Men and Angels
videos.overview: As Jesse eyes a business opportunity with an Evangelical couple on the rise, the media cracks down on a fellow preacher. Meanwhile, Eli reconnects with a figure from his mysterious past.

videos.title: After I Leave, Savage Wolves Will Come
videos.overview: After doubling-down on their efforts to invest in Zion’s Landing, Jesse and Amber scramble for the cash. Meanwhile, Eli’s attempts to dodge a big-city reporter spell doom for the Gemstones.

videos.title: For He Is a Liar and the Father of Lies
videos.overview: The Gemstone siblings seek to pull back the curtain on their father’s past. Eli shares a hard truth, and Kelvin grapples with an unruly God Squad.

videos.title: As to How They Might Destroy Him
videos.overview: Still reeling from their father’s revelation, Kelvin and Jesse conspire to put Eli in his place. As BJ’s baptism approaches, Judy clashes with her in-laws, while Baby Billy struggles with his own growing family.

videos.title: Interlude II
videos.overview: Christmas, 1993. While Eli considers a tempting offer from an old friend, Baby Billy crashes the Gemstones’ celebrations.

videos.title: Never Avenge Yourselves, But Leave It to the Wrath of God
videos.overview: After surviving a harrowing attack, Jesse takes matters into his own hands. Eli attempts to make amends, while Kelvin struggles to control his flock.

videos.title: And Infants Shall Rule Over Them
videos.overview: With Eli temporarily out of the picture, the Gemstone siblings are left to quarrel over who’s in charge – until some wise words help pave a way forward. As Tiffany tracks down Baby Billy, Gideon faces his future.

videos.title: The Prayer of a Righteous Man
videos.overview: As the dust settles back at the compound, Jesse, Kelvin, and Judy consider where they stand. Baby Billy reconnects with a figure from his past.

videos.title: I Will Tell of All Your Deeds
videos.overview: While the Gemstones celebrate the launch of Zion’s Landing, Baby Billy faces a chance to embrace fatherhood.

videos.title: For I Know the Plans I Have for You
videos.overview: In the wake of their father’s semi-retirement, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin must deal with dwindling attendance – and donations. Later, Eli is visited by another figure from his past.

videos.title: But Esau Ran to Meet Him
videos.overview: Eli does his best to smooth over relations with the Montgomery boys after a visit to their doomsday prepper compound. Back at the Salvation Center, the siblings face off against the Board of Ministers.

videos.title: For Their Nakedness Is Your Own Nakedness
videos.overview: Tired of life in the lap of luxury, Baby Billy pursues a new vocation as gameshow host. The Gemstones host a cousins’ night for Karl and Chuck.

videos.title: I Have Not Come to Bring Peace, But a Sword
videos.overview: While Jesse prepares for his initiation into a prestigious secret society, Judy fends off unwanted attention, and Kelvin handles rumors about Keefe. Later, Baby Billy makes an impossible promise.

videos.title: Interlude III
videos.overview: 2000. After a Y2K doomsday fails to materialize, Eli and Aimee-Leigh find themselves flooded with criticism from their congregants…and the Montgomerys. Later, the arrival of Jesse’s girlfriend Amber throws an already fragile Judy for a loop.

videos.title: For Out of the Heart Comes Evil Thoughts
videos.overview: Threatened with blackmail, Judy turns to Amber for advice, while Jesse goads BJ into a long-simmering fight. As a despondent Kelvin tackles life without Keefe, Baby Billy works on bringing Jesse’s miracle to life… for a price.

videos.title: Burn for Burn, Wound for Wound, Stripe for Stripe
videos.overview: After decades of animosity, tensions between the Montgomerys and the Gemstones finally come to a head. As Eli faces an impossible decision, Jesse, Judy, and Kelvin prepare to meet their maker.

videos.title: I Will Take You by the Hand and Keep You
videos.overview: The Gemstone siblings reconnect with their loved ones… and each other. As the Montgomery militia fractures from within, Chuck weighs his options, while Peter hatches a new plan.

videos.title: Wonders That Cannot Be Fathomed, Miracles That Cannot Be Counted
videos.overview: The siblings compete in an all-out biblical brawl – until a stroke of divine intervention forever alters the fate of the Gemstone family.

videos.title: Prelude
videos.overview: 1862. A young scoundrel named Gemstone joins ranks with the Confederates as a preacher, but a case of divine intervention changes the sinner's path for good.

videos.title: You Hurled Me into the Depths, into the Very Heart of the Seas
videos.overview: While preparing for a Give-a-Thon in honor of their late mother, the Gemstones reunite with Aimee-Leigh's longtime best friend Lori.

videos.title: To Grieve Like the Rest of Men Who Have No Hope
videos.overview: When their archrivals encroach on Gemstone territory, Jesse prepares to strike back, while Kelvin receives an honor.

videos.title: He Goeth Before You Into Galilee
videos.overview: At the Gemstone family lake house, Baby Billy and the siblings plot to use Aimee-Leigh's memory to tear Eli's new relationship apart – by whatever means necessary.

videos.title: You Shall Remember
videos.overview: While Lori finds herself in a precarious position, Baby Billy tries to get the greenlight on his latest project. Later, Kelvin and Vance face off.

videos.title: Interlude IV
videos.overview: 2002. While recording an album together, Lori turns to Aimee-Leigh for help with her failing marriage.

videos.title: For Jealousy Is the Rage of a Man
videos.overview: Eli confronts a dangerous foe. Baby Billy struggles on the set of Teenjus. Judy has monkey problems. Keefe works to get Kelvin out of his tree house.

videos.title: On Your Belly You Shall Go
videos.overview: Judy looks to get rid of BJ's new companion as Eli looks for a new path forward.

videos.title: That Man of God May Be Complete
videos.overview: Still reeling from a brush with fate, the Gemstones head to Galilee Gulch, where their faith is put to the ultimate test.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 wins & 34 nominations total
